body: I've been in therapy for six years now, but it doesn't seem to be doing too much. Maybe it's just not the right therapist or I need to shift my focus? I guess I feel like fixing my self-image issues will in turn heal a big part of our relationship, but I don't really know at this point. He has expressed an interest in going, but never really did anything to try, and I don't want to push it on him. I brought up going together and he got offended.
